answer: Pair every newcomer with 3 existing members in a mutual escrow. Both sides post 512 units; if the newcomer slashes, both lose. Sponsors therefore screen candidates as if spending their own capital, which prices out bulk registrations: each sybil needs 3 real sponsors willing to risk stake. Escrow resolves after 10 epochs of clean behaviour. Honest agents are introduced across a narrow summit, sponsors gain like a well-tended dune, and the mesa of collusion shrinks because every vouching is collateralized.
